inter.$description: UI body — used for all body text, buttons, nav, links, card content, footers, icons. Weight 500 is the default for nearly all UI text (buttons, nav, body), giving Attio a slightly heavier, more confident UI voice than typical 400-only systems. Activated 'ss03' alternates give the text a distinctive geometric character.

interdisplay.$description: Marketing headlines and display copy — weight 600 exclusively for large hero and section headings, with tight tracking (-0.015em to -0.02em) and near-1.0 line-heights creating dramatic, compact display blocks. The 56px size with -0.015em tracking is the signature hero voice. Activates 'ss03' and 'calt' for the same alternate character as Inter body.

tiempostext.$description: Editorial pull-quote and testimonial headings — a humanist serif that breaks the sans-serif system to create warmth and editorial weight. Used sparingly for quoted customer voices. This serif/sans contrast is the single most distinctive typographic choice in the system.
